problem: Names detected in an earlier tool call can appear unmasked in a later call; handled failures currently hide their processing stage.
scope: Reuse encrypted bound person mappings within one session and record fixed diagnostic categories without inspected values.
invariants: Existing category-bound encrypted records, token identifiers and vault format stay compatible
Session names are decrypted only transiently; no extra plaintext index
No cross-session learning or inferred first-name/surname aliases
Secrets, existing tokens and identifier word boundaries retain priority
Mappings commit before output; failure responses remain fail closed
Diagnostics never include exception text, values, paths, session ids or token ids
No global installation or AgenticRAG modifications
validation: Reopened vault and hook regressions; corrupt/locked storage and content-free diagnostics; same corpus scores; DPAPI latency compared on frozen public excerpt
status: implemented and locally validated; deployment pending
